title: What is response truncation?
summary: Truncation happens when the model's output stops before the requested response is complete. Example: User asks: Generate a complete Python application with 10 functions. The model returns: Then stops unexpectedly. The output is incomplete.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Truncation happens when the model's output stops before the requested response is complete.

Example:

User asks:

> Generate a complete Python application with 10 functions.

The model returns:

```python
def function_1():
    pass

def function_2():
    pass

def function_3():
    pass
```

Then stops unexpectedly.

The output is incomplete.
